as_told.title: Lunch with Jacques Vallée and the Satan book with 666 pages

plain: The computer scientist and UFO researcher Jacques Vallée once showed his guest an odd book from his collection, titled The History of Satan, with "big words on it that says Satan". The guest was Diana Pasulka, a professor who studies religion and UFO belief, and she says it happened while she was with him, which she places in his study in the San Francisco Bay Area. In one telling she sets it over lunch and adds that the book had 666 pages, the number the Bible ties to the beast.
